notes.title: Bugfix and menu translations
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where keyboard options were not saved correctly.
-Added Korean and Chinese menu translations (will add Japanese soon).

notes.title: Some fixes
notes.content:
-Fixed the Dragon Girl slacking off during the ending sequence
-Potentially fixed a a bug caused by music playing at a volume of 0 and not stopping.
-Fixed a bug where arrows appear on CG screens due to being carried over from the previous screen.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where the 2nd bosses peaces out.
-Changed menu controls so that the correct buttons back out.
-Fixed a visual bug.

-Fixed a bug where health is not restored on easiest mode checkpoints.
-Easy mode now has screen checkpoints and restores 1/2 health, while easiest restores full health like it was supposed to.

Let me know if you run into any other problems.

notes.title: The game has been released!
notes.content: The game is out! Should appear on the store page in about 10 minutes.

notes.title: Game should be released tomorrow!
notes.content: Eroico has passed review, so it can be released anytime. Will be releasing it tomorrow when people are actually awake and not at work.

notes.title: Demo released!
notes.content:
The demo has been released, should appear in about ten minutes if it hasn't already.

For those of you who havn't played it before, feel free to let me know what you think. Otherwise, let me know if you encounter any bugs or other problems.

notes.title: The demo has been sent for review.
notes.content: Finished updating a few things in the demo, and it has no been sent out for review. Guess we'll see in the next few days if pixel art is too lewd for Steam. (Or maybe the sound effects will do it.)

notes.title: Cloud saves work!
notes.content:
Got cloud saves to work, turns out they're pretty simple. Should also be shared between the demo and the full version.

With that I'm ready to put up the demo, however that also has to be reviewed before going live, so it will be a few days yet.
